note: Search API Location adds geospatial search to Search API. It registers two Search API data types: 'location' (Latitude/Longitude, for search_api_location_views) and 'rpt' (Spatial Recursive Prefix Tree, for facets_map_widget heatmaps); both convert a geofield WKT value to 'lat,lon' via geoPHP centroid at index time. It defines a 'location_input' plugin type (manager plugin.manager.search_api_location.location_input, annotation @LocationInput, base LocationInputPluginBase) with plugins raw and geocode_map (the geocoder submodule adds 'geocode'). Distance units km/mi via search_api_location_get_units(); hooks hook_search_api_location_units_alter and hook_search_api_location_input_info_alter. The backend must support the data types (Solr known-good; DB backend does not). No settings form (configure=search_api.overview); everything is configured on a Search API index's Fields page. Medium/hard cases are grounded in a self-contained Search API index (sal_test_index, no server) indexing a geofield (field_sal_geo) as the location/rpt data types - no external map/geocoder libraries required.

evals.prompt: Which Search API data types does the search_api_location module add, and what is each one used for?
evals.expected_output: It adds two data types: 'location' (Latitude/Longitude) used for Views distance filtering/sorting (search_api_location_views), and 'rpt' (Spatial Recursive Prefix Tree) used for facet heatmaps (facets_map_widget). Both convert a geofield value to a lat,lon string via geoPHP.

evals.prompt: How do I make a geofield searchable by proximity with search_api_location, and what backend requirement must I be aware of?
evals.expected_output: On the Search API index's Fields page, add the geofield and set its Type to Latitude/longitude (location) for Views, and/or Recursive Prefix Tree (rpt) for heatmap facets. The backend must support these spatial data types - Search API Solr does; the database backend does not.

evals.prompt: In search_api_location, how does an end user specify the point to search from, what plugin type governs that, and which input plugins ship out of the box?
evals.expected_output: A Location Input plugin (plugin type 'location_input', annotation @LocationInput, manager plugin.manager.search_api_location.location_input). The base module ships 'raw' (type lat,lon) and 'geocode_map' (pick on a map); the search_api_location_geocoder submodule adds 'geocode' (geocode an address).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Search API index named sal_test_index. Inspect it and give the id of the field that is indexed with the Latitude/Longitude (location) data type.
evals.expected_output: The field sal_loc on index sal_test_index has data type 'location' (Latitude/Longitude); it indexes the field_sal_geo geofield.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Search API index sal_test_index indexes a geofield twice. Inspect it and give the id of the field that uses the Spatial Recursive Prefix Tree (rpt) data type used for facet heatmaps.
evals.expected_output: The field sal_rpt on index sal_test_index has data type 'rpt' (Spatial Recursive Prefix Tree).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Search API index sal_test_index has a field sal_loc (indexing the field_sal_geo geofield) but it is set to the wrong data type. Using search_api_location, configure that field to be indexed as Latitude/Longitude so it can be used for proximity search, and apply the change to the live index.
evals.expected_output: Set the sal_loc field's data type to 'location' on index sal_test_index (via the Fields UI or Index::getField('sal_loc')->setType('location') then save). The verify checks sal_loc's type is 'location'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Search API index sal_test_index indexes the field_sal_geo geofield only for distance search. To enable an interactive heatmap facet, add the geofield to the index as a Spatial Recursive Prefix Tree (rpt) field, and apply the change to the live index.
evals.expected_output: Add a field to sal_test_index (indexing field_sal_geo) with data type 'rpt' (e.g. a new Field with id like sal_rpt, setType('rpt')), then save the index. The verify checks the index now has at least one field of type 'rpt'.
